title: Surreal Painted Face
description: A close-up portrait of a person's face with eyes closed, partially submerged and transformed by flowing, textured paint. The face features distinct horizontal bands of vibrant turquoise, lime green, and crimson red that appear to melt and drip, with ornate golden line details and organic pink coral-like growths emerging from the skin.
prompt: extreme close-up surreal portrait of a young man's face with eyes closed, his skin transformed into flowing horizontal bands of vibrant turquoise, lime green and deep red paint that appear to melt and ripple like water and clouds, intricate golden filigree lines tracing across the colors, textured pink coral and organic growths emerging from the left cheek and jaw, dramatic dark background with floating purple particles, hyper-detailed oil painting style with visible brushwork and texture
